description: The chart illustrates GLUE performance values for different parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, with results shown separately for two RoBERTa model sizes. The category axis is horizontal and labeled “Fine-tuning Method,” with method names shown in a left-to-right order that includes (as visible) “LoRA,” “BitFit,” “S1-model,” “S4-model,” and “S5-model.” The value axis is vertical and labeled “GLUE Performance,” using a linear numeric scale; visible tick labels include 86 and 88 (with evenly spaced ticks implied), and the plotted bar heights extend to roughly the high-80s/around 90. Bars are grouped by method, with two adjacent bars per group corresponding to the legend “RoBERTa Size”: a blue bar for “base” and an orange bar for “large.” Approximate bar heights (from the visible portion) show LoRA at about ~88.5 (base, blue) and ~89.5 (large, orange), BitFit at about ~86.6 (base) and ~89.2 (large), S1-model at about ~88.8 (base) and ~89.0 (large), S4-model at about ~89.3 (base) and ~90.0 (large), and S5-model at about ~89.8 (base) with the large (orange) bar extending above the visible top boundary of the cropped image. The bars do not appear to be explicitly sorted by height, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the color legend.
